text:
maya (PM): Heads-up: LargeFin asked if we can support tenant-held keys + a 5-year audit evidence lane. They want the ability to flip retention only for audit/evidence and have an audit of the flip. quick thoughts?

kevin (security): Technically OK but we need: KMS attestation, export integrity proof (signed manifest + checksum), and documented chain-of-custody. legal will want the attestation matrix.

ron (eng-infra): Storage plan: cold-object store for 5y blobs + separate metadata index for export lookups. Search will be limited (export-by-range only). We'll need lifecycle jobs and cost estimate.

tara (ops): Operational control: propose two modes: (A) Pilot/manual toggle via support ticket (requires SRE approval) (B) GA self-serve toggle in Console with 2FA + billing consent. Pilot reduces blast radius.

jade (sales): Customer prefers Console toggle. They said procurement insists on an upfront onboarding checklist and proof-of-export for audits. They'll pay for premium if UI exists.

maya (PM): Decision points: self-serve vs support-only; billing model (flat onboarding + monthly archival per-GB vs purely per-GB); maximum temporary extension window; legal_hold behavior.

kevin (security): Also require export SLO: evidence bundle generated within X hours for compliance audits. propose 48h max for pilot, 12h for GA.

ron (eng-infra): API sketch for toggle:
PATCH /api/v1/tenants/TID/settings
{ "retention_policy": "archival", "scopes": ["audit_logs","evidence"], "duration_days": 1825 }

plus endpoint to request export:
POST /api/v1/tenants/TID/exports { "scope":"evidence", "from":"2021-01-01", "to":"2025-01-01" }
deploy-bot: deploy started: feature/retention-archival -> staging (build 4823)

tara (ops): Escape-hatch idea: allow temporary extension (<=30d) via support with auto-revert + required signed approval from customer admin. ops will log a signed approval hash into audit stream.

kevin (security): Add legal_hold flag: when set, deletions and auto-reverts are blocked until legal_hold cleared by authorized principal. This must be surfaced in Console and API.

jade (sales): Pricing ask from customer: they want a 12-month price cap for archival during pilot. can we model that?

ron (eng-infra): We can add a billing cap toggle per-tenant that stops ingest when reached or alerts. Implementation requires billing guardrails in the pipeline.

maya (PM): Proposed MVP (pilot): - Manual BYOK onboarding (support-driven) - Manual retention flips by support (<=30d temp) - Exportable evidence bundles with signed manifest and checksum - Billing: onboarding fee + per-GB/month archival; optional 12-month cap as contractual override - Launch gates: security attestation doc, ops runbook, legal ok, pilot customer sig-off

kevin (security): Gate: no GA BYOK until HSM attestation + legal signoff. For pilot ok with caveats.

tara (ops): Runbook items: verify-keystore-ownership, record approval hash, schedule export job, verify checksum after export, populate evidence manifest. Also on-call play for failed exports.

ron (eng-infra): Risk note: restoring archived evidence for quick search could be expensive. recommend export-first approach and provide a sampled index for metadata only.

jade (sales): I'll prepare a procurement one-pager with attestation checklist and pilot terms. Need PM copy of the export manifest template.

maya (PM): Action list: ron -> EOW storage + cost estimate; kevin -> attestation checklist draft by Tue; tara -> ops runbook skeleton by Wed; jade -> one-pager draft by Thu. I'll open a kanban card and tag stakeholders.
deploy-bot: job 4823 staging deploy successful

kevin (security): small doc note: export manifest should include file checksums (sha256), key IDs referenced, timestamp, signed-by (service-key), and customer signature when applicable.

maya (PM): OK locking this: Q2 pilot (support-only, manual onboarding), Q3 tentative GA (self-serve + integrated billing) pending gates. Thanks team.
